description: This file defines the AWS DynamoDbClient class, which provides methods to interact with the Amazon DynamoDB service. It includes method annotations for various DynamoDB operations, configuration methods, and a session handler registration method.

classes.name: DynamoDbClient
classes.description: A client class to interact with Amazon DynamoDB, supporting various database operations and configuration options.

methods.name: getArguments
methods.description: Returns the default configuration arguments for the client, including retry and API provider settings.

methods.name: registerSessionHandler
methods.description: Creates and registers a DynamoDB session handler using this client.

methods.name: _applyRetryConfig
methods.description: Internal method to apply retry configuration to the handler list.

methods.name: _applyApiProvider
methods.description: Internal method to apply the API provider and parser configurations.
